recruiterCard.summary: Built a forecasting pipeline for daily US equities that ranks signals, explains predictions and evaluates calibration.
impactBullets: Built a FastAPI backend that serves ranked equity signals from daily market data with SHAP-backed explanations.
Implemented evaluation with ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, Brier scores and calibration curves.
Designed reproducible feature datasets and walk-forward backtests for evidence-based model selection.
